limitations.detail: Original tall empty-result UI layout spans two inline pages. The exact full native layout and the appendix retain the complete source.

Sixty-pixel overlapping annex crops can divide connector lines and portions of labels across neighboring tiles; adjacent tiles and the whole native figure must be read together. Individual tiles do not imply every label is complete within that single tile.
Original empty viewport areas and white margins generate sparse annex pages, including layout tiles 3 and 4 and rightmost diagram strips.
Some tall inline full-figure overviews have compact text; appendix and full native originals provide the readable enlarged representation.
Related-document target existence and final output routing remain a whole-bundle gate.
